summary: SABESP furnished Amendment No. 1 to a Form 6-K originally filed September 23, 2026, solely to clarify that its amended bylaws reflecting a share-capital increase, approved by shareholders on July 30, 2026, have not yet taken effect. The bylaws will become effective upon completion of unspecified corporate events, after which the company will update investors. No special-situation transaction, price, stake, premium or advisor is disclosed; the filing is a routine administrative clarification of an earlier report and requires no deal-terms analysis.
